title: Looking for game testers
author: 2nd_breakfastt
selftext:
Looking for some people to try out my game and let me know if they get attached to any of the villagers. If yes I’d love to hear your story, if no please let me know what can be improved or added to achieve that

Check out the itch io page for more info on the game and the demo! https://ynotved.itch.io/hearth-heirs

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/2nd_breakfastt please share some more about how you used AI in developing this. Naming the tools or saying "made with AI" doesn't count. Rule 4 is how we keep promotional posts contributing, by having them talk about the process and how the game was made. Trying to keep the sub focused on dev. This post may be removed if it isn't updated.

comments.author: 2nd_breakfastt
comments.body: ChatGPT/Claude was used for game design, brainstorming, coding assistance, and artwork generation. Claude for writing, implementing, and debugging code. Godot 4 as the game engine using GDScript. Blender with Claude for 3D modeling and working with game assets

comments.author: BusinessZestyclose86
comments.body: ooo this looks really fun, I’ll try it out first thing in the morning.

replies.author: 2nd_breakfastt
replies.body: Awesome! Excited to hear your thoughts

replies.author: BusinessZestyclose86
replies.body: Awesome game! I really liked the young guy Rowan! My only bug report was that a new couple joined and I couldn't get them to move into an empty cottage I built for them.

replies.author: 2nd_breakfastt
replies.body: Hey glad you liked it! Yes, that does need to be fixed. In its current state, only “couples” are able to move into the cottage. Where all the other villagers only have the long hut to use for sleeping quarters. I’ll look to adjust the rules of the cottage so that they’re available to all villagers that need a bed. Thank you for your feedback

replies.author: BusinessZestyclose86
replies.body: Actually, I think it only being available to couple is a good challenge so you root for people to get together! The people who moved in was a couple expecting a baby so that’s more so what I mean there. They just slept in the hall 😭

replies.author: 2nd_breakfastt
replies.body: Heard! I’ll look into the situation where a couple moves in and then does not have access to the cottage thanks for bringing that up. Other than obvious art polishing/animation clippings let me know if you notice anything else!

comments.author: bugnetio
comments.body:
From this short video here is some feedback.

\- Come up with your own name for the game.  
\- make the smoke coming out of the houses not happen identically at the same time.  
\- have people greet each other when they meet, folks don’t leave their house saying hello  
\- add more variety to the town models

replies.author: bugnetio
replies.body:
From watching your video on itch:  
the non player characters look Claude gen with improper skeletons.  
\- animations clip into each other  
\- river bank to water has no decoration besides a straight line grass to water  
\- show more actual gameplay. Is the game reading a little bit and clicking a button?

I like the weather system you added, I think that’s a cool bit. Think of things that make a world feel alive and lean into those elements.

Show the gameplay, I have no clue from your video what the gameplay is?

replies.author: 2nd_breakfastt
replies.body:
Hey thanks for the feedback. 

Started this project a couple days ago so admittedly there’s a lot of improvement needed such as the art assets, animations, etc

This short clip was only meant to draw interest to my itch page that further explains the game with a more detailed gameplay trailer

Heard on your feedback, was blind to the chimney smoke until you mentioned that, thanks

Planning to add more building models, better villager assets and animations, more depth to the gameplay, more reasons to get attached to your villagers and more.
